remarks: Space, privacy, and effortless California living await at 3443 Mandeville Canyon. Set on an expansive 24,540-square-foot lot, this beautifully renovated three-bedroom, three-bath residence pairs inviting interiors with exceptional outdoor amenities. A flowing layout connects generous living spaces to a backyard designed for both entertaining and unwinding. A recently added pool, lush lawns, and a built-in barbecue area set the scene for weekend celebrations, leisurely swims, and dinners under the stars. The peaceful canyon setting and birdsong bring a sense of retreat to everyday lifea welcoming place to gather, recharge, and call home!
